          title: Address

        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            supplied (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' input and is
            normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common street-type
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or apartment). When present it is normalized and appended to
            the composed 'address' after 'addressLine1' with a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per a fixed city-to-region table
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD

          type: string

          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-0-9 ()+.]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'

          writeOnly: true

            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as '<title> <lastName>' when a

              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'
                where REGION is the region code derived from the owner's postcode
                (falling back to the city), FY is the 2-digit fiscal year of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate (see 'fiscalYear'), HASH8 is
                the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest over the
                owner's normalized telephone concatenated with its last name, and CHK
                is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Unifies the former customerCode and
                membershipNumber into one identifier.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year that the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate falls in. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is labelled by the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registrationDate on or after 1 July belongs to the next year's
                fiscal year (e.g. 2026-08-11 -> 'FY27', 2026-01-05 -> 'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners in the same household, derived
                from the owner's last name and address. Owners with the same last
                name and address (compared case-insensitively with collapsed
                whitespace) share the same value, so members created via the
                'sharesHousehold' flag receive the same household ID.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A9C1B4D6E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId>'. All
                duplicate detection is consolidated into this single key: creating
                an owner is rejected with 409 Conflict only when its whole identity
                key equals an existing owner's. Because the telephone is part of the
                key, two members of the same household with different telephones have
                different identity keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3F2A9C1B4D6E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Fixed when the owner is created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, fixed at creation. Starts at 0,
                plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0,
                plus 2 for a household of 3 or more members, plus 3 for a tenure
                of more than one elapsed fiscal year (the number of fiscal years
                between the owner's registration date and the current server
                date, where the fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, fixed at creation, mapped
                from membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or
                more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, derived from the city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-

                the region has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for the
                owner's registration date at the time this owner was created,
                signalling a bulk-signup surge; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, its city already

                per-city capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, it was not a hard

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at creation:

              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:

              description: >-
